official_definition: Twinkle Catalyze: [Color] (When Advents) Immediately activate one of your [Color] Soul Bursts. After that Burst activates, you can set a card with Burst effects from your Hand.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Twinkle Catalyze] or [Twinkle Catalyze: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Twinkle Catalyze]", "give [Twinkle Catalyze]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
